title: Document outline
summary: List the headings of a Markdown text with levels and lines.

inputs.markdown:
# Report
Intro.
## Scope
In scope.
### Detail
More.
## Risks
None.

sections.use: See the structure of a Markdown document: each heading's level, text and line number.
sections.exclusions: Only ATX headings (#). Setext headings, block quotes and lists are not recognised.
sections.limitations: Markdown up to 1 MiB; at most 2,000 headings, after which truncated is true.
sections.missing_data: A text without headings gives an empty list.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

outputs.out: The headings in order and whether the list was truncated.
